title: Rust SOS: add per-origin monotonic seq gate + AddrForKey origin addr on RX/TX
description: Rust slice of b7z9.121 (spec 18.4.1). Rust lichen-node SOS RX path has NO per-origin monotonic Origin Sequence gate (C gate exists but unwired, Python has one) - add last-seen-per-origin tracking in the SOS RX handler and reject non-advancing sequences. Also synthesize origin IPv6 via AddrForKey(pubkey) (lichen-core addr.rs) on both TX (sign) and RX (verify), not any 0200::IID synthesis. Rust is the only stack with a real pinned transcript digest (sos_origin.rs:160-173) - extend that oracle to cover the AddrForKey origin address and the seq gate. Cross-stack wire compat: coordinate with C/Python address slices.
